name_input: SANGIR PLASTICS PVT. LTD.,; SANGIR PLASTIC PVT LTD; SANGIR PLASTICS PVT. LTD.; SANGIR PLASTICS PRIVATE LIMITED; SANGIR PLASTICS PVT LTD
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page for SANGIR PLASTICS PVT LTD (SANGIR HOUSE, 366/2933, MOTILAL NAGAR NO. 2, GOREGAON) shows 2412 shipment records, 38 trading partners, 51 ports, latest cargo 2026-02-28. Exact export rows seen (5 of 5 displayed): "2026-02-27 | SANGIR PLASTICS PVT LTD | SANGIR INTERNATIONAL LLC | ARTICLES MADE OF 100% HDPE CONTAINS (SHEETS)- HDPE SHEET-TYPE 02 (15 NOS)(67.50 SQM) | NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India -> Port Kelang, MALAYSIA | HS 39201019 | BOL 1100617"; "2026-02-25 | SANGIR PLASTICS PVT LTD | AL JASSAR LLC | ARTICLES MADE OF PVDF CONTAINS (FITTINGS) PVDF FITTINGS- TYPE 14 | NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India -> Sohar, OMAN | HS 39174000 | BOL 1021883"; "2026-02-24 | SANGIR PLASTICS PVT LTD | SANGIR INTERNATIONAL LLC | ARTICLES MADE OF 100% PPH CONTAINS PPH SHEET-TYPE 01 (470 NOS) (QTY : 2115.00 SQM) | NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India -> Lisboa, PORTUGAL | HS 39211200 | BOL 9965898"; "2026-02-21 | SANGIR PLASTICS PVT LTD | SANGIR INTERNATIONAL LLC | ARTICLES MADE OF 100% HDPE CONTAINS (FITTINGS) HDPE FITTINGS-TYPE 01 (QTY : 2 NOS) | NHAVA SHEVA SEA INNSA1, India -> Dinnington, UNITED KINGDOM | HS 39174000 | BOL 9880082". Second slug /sangir-plastics-private-limited (Palsana Road, Motiwada, Surat) shows 403 records, latest 2025-11-29, with export buyers AQUATHERM LP (USA), P2X GMBH (Germany), MATRIX PIPING SYSTEMS (Australia), COW-WELFARE A/S (Denmark), WATER AND ENVIRONMENT TECHNOLOGIES CO (Saudi Arabia). Source counter: ImportKey states 2412 total shipments; 5 export rows actually rendered on the page (rest behind paywall). Third slug /sangir-plastic-pvt-ltd returned an empty page (0 rows).
domestic_evidence: No verifiable domestic-supply record obtained. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender awards and annual-report domestic/export splits were not retrievable: DuckDuckGo search backend returned "searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>" on all three queries, volza.com and thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403. No GSTIN, turnover figure or domestic contract line was seen, so none is asserted.
note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated India customs shipping-bill rows with B/L numbers, destination countries and HS codes exist for both entity variants (Goregaon/Mumbai and Palsana/Surat). Declared HS 391722 (polymers of propylene, rigid tubes/pipes) does not match the observed export lines, which are HS 39201019 (HDPE sheets), 39211200 (PPH sheets) and 39174000 (plastic fittings) — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; actual HS should be recorded as 3920/3917 family (sheets and fittings), verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Note the company is a converter/trader of HDPE/PPH/PVDF semi-finished products (sheets, fittings) rather than a 391722 pipe producer, and it also imports raw polymer (Borouge HDPE granules HS 39012000, QatarEnergy MDPE HS 39012000) — role best described as manufacturer_trader. Domestic supply: no traces found in accessible sources, but this is a source-access failure, not evidence of absence, hence unknown rather than none_found. Revenue and export volume figures: null (not public in accessible sources; ImportKey shows only record counts, not values).
